chose: An analytics retry is due its successive delay (1, 5, 30, 120, 360 minutes) after the failure it follows, so retries fall 1, 6, 36, 156 and 516 minutes after the first failure only when PostHog fails at once; a 10 s timeout shifts each later retry by its own wait
over: Scheduling every retry from the first failure's instant, which needs a stored first-failure time
because: O18 states the rule as successive delays and the core loop's R29 schedule works the same way; the cumulative minutes are its consequence for instant failures, and a stored first-failure time is a field for nothing a reader can observe
